description: Admin UI surface for triaging pending MCP submissions from mcp_submissions table. Must include: submission queue table (mcp_name, requested_by, submitted_at, current_status), approve/reject workflow actions, and notes field for conditional approvals. Ports to localhost:8790. Reads via write_service :8772 /query, writes decisions via :8772/write to mcp_submissions. Table columns: submission_id, mcp_name, mcp_identifier, requested_by, submitted_at, status, reviewer_notes.
